description: Authoritative English for every string in the R34 item database (SLPM-65378 Busin 0), realigned from chunk_md_import.json (+1-shift pockets corrected per-sub; first entry of each shifted sub is aligned, the duplicate/split md rows absorb at the sub sentinel). Consumed by the wave-2 variable-length R34 injector. Schema: entries[] of {sub, idx (item index within sub, 0 = empty placeholder), msg (Step-2 0-indexed global message id), jp (decoded Japanese, glyph-map garble preserved), english (ASCII), preserve_prefix}. english is plain text; line wrapping is the injector's responsibility. Empty english + empty jp = placeholder row: injector must keep original bytes. preserve_prefix=true (all 56 sub9 spell-book descriptions): the original byte stream begins [FF07|FF02]<class+level header>[FFF0]; english's segment before the first " / " is the translation of that header and must be re-wrapped in the same FFxx ... FFF0 control codes; the remainder is the body. Names: r39_name_reuse.json anchors are copied verbatim; spell names use the shipped R39 spellings (Kreta/Kurudo/Teal...); categories follow shipped R39 (Spell Book, Wand, Cudgel, ? Shortsword...). Placeholder valuables use canonical "Key Item N" (kichouhin = Key Items).
